title: How I Respond To Believers IRL

top_liked.author: @gabe6646
top_liked.text: You gotta pray to stay out of trouble, then when that doesn't work, you gotta pray to get out. Then when the problem goes away as many problems do, with time. You get to thank God for the whole experience.

top_liked.author: @kariannecrysler
top_liked.text: My last encounter was bad. The youngster went into a rehearsed mantra to get himself to reject the true things I had said and to make me and the truth the “devil”. I teared up. That poor pathetic person who couldn’t even accept reality because it challenged his beliefs in a god…

top_liked.author: @unknownx7252
top_liked.text: I follow many deconstruction and deconversion channels. What I noticed is that most of the white channels I follow tend to land on atheist or agnostic. With the black channels, most tend to land on the law of attraction, yoga, ancestal spirits, Christology, and others. Why do…

top_liked.author: @ThePew-Breaker
top_liked.text: You pray for me, I'll think for you.

top_liked.text: I claim something similar when I respond, "I don't believe anything supernatural". Usually they will pause and then repeat what I have said in order to understand and to be clear about what I have said, and at that point it has likely become somewhat "embedded".
